description: This file defines the TransactionAgentStatistics class which implements ITransactionAgentStatistics interface. It tracks transaction metrics such as started, succeeded, failed, and throttled transactions using counters and provides methods to update these metrics. It also includes a static method to copy statistics from another instance.

classes.name: TransactionAgentStatistics
classes.description: Implements transaction metrics tracking for Orleans transactions, including counters for started, successful, failed, and throttled transactions.

methods.name: TransactionAgentStatistics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes counters for transaction metrics.

methods.name: TransactionsStarted
methods.description: Property that returns the number of transactions started.

methods.name: TransactionsSucceeded
methods.description: Property that returns the number of successful transactions.

methods.name: TransactionsFailed
methods.description: Property that returns the number of failed transactions.

methods.name: TransactionsThrottled
methods.description: Property that returns the number of throttled transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionStarted
methods.description: Method to increment the count of started transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionSucceeded
methods.description: Method to increment the count of successful transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionFailed
methods.description: Method to increment the count of failed transactions.

methods.name: TrackTransactionThrottled
methods.description: Method to increment the count of throttled transactions.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Static method to create a copy of transaction statistics from an existing instance.
